title: All These Things Will Be Added to You?
description: This sermon emphasizes the true meaning behind seeking first the kingdom of God and His righteousness, clarifying that the promise of 'all these things will be added to you' in Matthew 6:33 refers to everything needed to glorify God, which may include challenges or suffering. The message challenges the common misinterpretation of this verse to justify material wealth and prosperity. It also draws on 2 Corinthians 9:8 and Philippians 4:19 to highlight that God's provision is tailored to our specific needs for His purposes, even if it involves hardships or a simple lifestyle.
